svg.title: Where the tubercles go
svg.desc: Where the tubercles go, after Gin Seok Song. Two planforms, leading edge at the top. Left, the first try, with tubercles along the whole span: good glide, but the tips stall early and the wing spun early. Right, tubercles on the central 60% of the span; the tips keep a plain leading edge.
svg.text: good glide, but the tips stall early
the tips keep a plain leading edge
planforms, leading edge at the top
